sources.entry: Muxie - Last.fm scrobbler for Apple Music, Spotify Desktop, iPod Classic, Rockbox devices and some others. ![Freeware][Freeware Icon]

summary.name: Muxie
summary.one_liner: Muxie is a native macOS Last.fm scrobbler that automatically logs plays from Apple Music, Spotify Desktop, and iPod or Rockbox portable devices.
use_cases: Scrobble Apple Music plays to Last.fm on a Mac
Scrobble Spotify desktop listening to Last.fm
Import plays from an iPod classic or video to Last.fm
Upload Rockbox player listening history via .scrobbler.log
View personal play counts and top artists on Last.fm
summary.what_it_does: Muxie runs in the background on macOS and scrobbles a track to Last.fm once it has played halfway through, for Apple Music and Spotify Desktop. It shows play, artist and album counts for the current song, and lists top artists, albums and tracks over several time frames. For iPod Classic and Rockbox-based devices, it scans the connected device and lets the user choose which tracks to scrobble, using either Apple's iPod data or a .scrobbler.log file. Scrobbles made while offline are queued and sent once the connection returns. It uses Last.fm's official authentication, so it does not see the user's password.
notable: Supports iPod classic and Rockbox .scrobbler.log import
Offline scrobble queue sends plays once back online
Uses official Last.fm authentication; no analytics or tracking per the page
Mark songs as loved directly from the app
caveats: Requires macOS Big Sur (v11.5) or later
Official iPod support is limited to iPod classic (6th gen) and iPod video (5th gen) on Apple software; other models may be tricky
